name: Rave / hardcore
blurb: Breakbeats, a hoover, piano chords and a stab from a sampler.

sounds.why: A sped-up funk break in place of a drum machine. This is the step that turned house into hardcore, and later into jungle.
A long, plain sub under the break. The drums are busy, so the bass is not.

sounds.name: Rave stab
sounds.why: A whole chord sampled as one key, bright and blunt, played like a drum.

sounds.name: Piano riff
sounds.why: Happy major-sounding piano over dark drums and bass. That clash is the whole mood of 1992.
The swell into the drop, usually with the break filtered out underneath it.
